name: Sleep apnea clinic
summary: How expats evaluate sleep apnea care in Singapore — home vs lab sleep studies, CPAP titration, ENT surgical paths, and insurance hurdles for devices.
body:
Sleep apnea clinics investigate snoring, daytime sleepiness, and witnessed apneas. Pathways usually start with a GP or ENT, then a sleep study (home or lab) before CPAP, oral appliances, or surgery discussions.

## Decision points
- Home sleep test vs attended lab study
- CPAP trial / titration logistics
- Oral appliance vs device vs ENT surgery
- Travel-friendly machine and mask fitting
- Insurance cover for studies and CPAP rentals/purchases

Bring a partner’s snore/apnea notes if possible.

## How to choose
Prefer clinics that explain study type and follow-up clearly. Ask who adjusts CPAP pressure after the first weeks. Confirm device loaner policies before buying hardware.

## Practical tip
Block two quiet nights after starting CPAP. Mask leaks and dry mouth tweaks are normal — do not abandon after night one.
